message.content: {"note_claim": "Europeans have been using soap and washing/bathing for thousands of years (soap existed in the Roman era and earlier).", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "It is another 2000 years before both Greek (Galen, Method of Medicine, VIII. line 569k) and Roman (Pliny, Natural History, XXVIII.191; Martial, Epigrams, VIII.20; XIV.27 & 27) authors mention soap.", "reason": "The page establishes that Roman and Greek authors mention soap by the first century AD, which indirectly supports European soap use, but it focuses on soap's origins (largely Mesopotamian) and says nothing about European bathing habits, bathhouses, or saunas."}

parsed.note_claim: Europeans have been using soap and washing/bathing for thousands of years (soap existed in the Roman era and earlier).
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: It is another 2000 years before both Greek (Galen, Method of Medicine, VIII. line 569k) and Roman (Pliny, Natural History, XXVIII.191; Martial, Epigrams, VIII.20; XIV.27 & 27) authors mention soap.
parsed.reason: The page establishes that Roman and Greek authors mention soap by the first century AD, which indirectly supports European soap use, but it focuses on soap's origins (largely Mesopotamian) and says nothing about European bathing habits, bathhouses, or saunas.
